corrections.why: The register describes a 40-foot wooden tower at Castle Rock.

notes_for_editor: Only the register gives the 1912 to 1913 history; no newspaper, state forestry or town record was found. The register does not say where the 1913 permanent tower stood. The Harts Hill tower (US 41) was also first operated in 1913, so the story does not link the two. The firelookout.org Wakefield page named in search results would not load (DNS error, then 404), so it is unchecked. The Castle Rock peak in Breakheart Reservation shares the name, but no source says it is the same hill; the story says so. The 2022 Breakheart wildland fires are not tied to the site and are left out. Next checks: Wakefield Historical Society, Wakefield Public Library, and Massachusetts forestry records for the 1912 agreement. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the register gives Castle Rock coordinates (N 42° 29.840' W 071° 02.540') and Harts Hill coordinates (N 42° 29.400' W 071° 03.970'), about 2 km apart; the story does not use them, and the register gives no separate location for the 1913 permanent tower.
